The name for the fluxConfigurations resource in Azure. Maximum of 30 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character. Learn more about setting up GitOps configuration: https://aka.ms/doc-use-flux2.

The namespace in the cluster within which the Flux custom resources will be installed for this configuration. This can be an existing namespace or a new one that will be created when the configuration is deployed. Maximum of 63 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character.
The permission scope for the Flux configuration. Possible values are 'cluster' (create resources throughout cluster) or 'namespace' (create resources only in namespace).
Enable force to instruct the controller to recreate resources if they can't be changed due to an immutable field change.
The name of the Kustomization. Maximum of 30 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphen. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character.
The path within the source where the Kustomization will begin looking for manifests to reconcile. If left blank, the root path of the repository will be used.

Enable prune to assure that objects are removed from the cluster if they are removed from the GitRepository or Bucket source or when this Kustomization or GitOps configuration is removed from the cluster.
The retry interval, in seconds, specifies how often the Kustomization will retry a previously failed reconciliation. If left blank, the value of the sync interval will be used.

The sync interval, in seconds, defines how often the Kustomization reconciles the cluster with the manifests to ensure that the cluster remains in sync with the GitRepository or Bucket source. A Kustomization sync interval more frequent than the source sync interval can be used to catch and reconcile any cluster drift.
The sync timeout, in seconds, defines how long a Kustomization reconciliation will be allowed to continue before timing out.
The base64-encoded HTTPS certificate authority contents used to access private git repositories over HTTPS.
The branch within the GitRepository source to sync to the cluster.
The commit SHA within the GitRepository source to sync to the cluster. Takes precedence over semver and tag. May be used with branch.
The tag semver range within the GitRepository source to reconcile with the cluster. Takes precedence over tag and branch.
The tag within the GitRepository source to sync to the cluster. Takes precedence over branch.
The time period, in seconds, between attempted syncs of the Git repository to the cluster.
The maximum allowed time, in seconds, for syncing the Git repository to the cluster, after which the sync fails and tries again in the next sync interval.
The URL for the Git repository. Formats supported: http://, https://, ssh://.
Enable or disable the execution of the policy

List of Kubernetes namespaces to exclude from policy evaluation. System namespaces "kube-system", "gatekeeper-system" and "azure-arc" are always excluded by design. "azure-extensions-usage-system" is optional to remove.
Label query to select Kubernetes resources for policy evaluation. An empty label selector matches all Kubernetes resources.

schema.description: A label selector is a label query over a set of resources. The result of matchLabels and matchExpressions are ANDed. An empty label selector matches all resources.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of values, a key, and an operator.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values.

values.description: values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn, the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist, the values array must be empty.

matchLabels.description: matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs.
